open_items: SBS provider_down continuously from cycle 1107 (2026-10-25T10:01Z) through cycle 1123 (2026-10-26T18:01Z): 17 consecutive cycles, about 32 hours, no recovery. Same failure shape as before (gateway metadata Error: empty, gateway data timeout, direct metadata/data/json all ConnectTimeout). Has not crossed the previous run's 48h re-escalation threshold and the shape has not changed, so not re-alerted this run. Re-check next run; alert again only if it crosses 48h or the failure shape changes.

ECB flapped healthy -> provider_down -> healthy within a single intermediate cycle: provider_down at cycle 1121 (2026-10-26T14:01Z, gateway metadata Error: empty plus direct metadata ReadTimeout), healthy again by cycle 1122 (2026-10-26T16:01Z) and through cycle 1123. Reported this run as resolved. Re-open and alert only if ECB fails again; a single isolated blip is not yet a pattern.

Empty-message gateway error pattern ('gateway metadata: Error:' with no text) has now been seen on two different endpoints: ABS at cycle 26, ECB at cycle 1121. Worth a closer look at the gateway's error-reporting path if a third occurrence happens, but not actioned by this read-only routine.

ESTAT gateway metadata latency flap (climbed toward the 60s deadline through cycles 1102-1113, crossed it once at 1113, recovered at 1114): already reported, working as designed. No further climb observed through cycle 1123.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1123: listing served without credentials. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flipped again at this run's /api/contracts read (was/now swap, verdict stays ok). Long-known cosmetic flip, not an incident.

Branch count for claude/ triage branches not re-checked this run (not fetched with the wider glob); last known count was 98 as of cycle 1120, already above the 20 the skill flags for pruning. Not actioned by this read-only routine.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
